Louis V. Gerstner, Jr.

Louis V. Gerstner Jr. (1942–2025) was the founder and Chairman of Gerstner Philanthropies. He established the foundation with a belief in rigorous thinking, opportunity, and sustained impact, shaping its mission and values for decades. He served as chief executive officer and chairman of the board of IBM Corporation from April 1993 to March 2002 and chairman until his retirement in December 2002.
